title.zh: 将本格特省古雷尔—博科德—卡巴扬—阿巴坦公路更名为Andres Acop Cosalan众议员公路的法案
title.en: An Act Renaming the Gurel-Bokod-Kabayan-Abatan Road in the Province of Benguet to Cong. Andres Acop Cosalan Road
title.orig: An Act Renaming the Gurel-Bokod-Kabayan-Abatan Road in the Province of Benguet to Cong. Andres Acop Cosalan Road
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Đường Gurel-Bokod-Kabayan-Abatan tại Tỉnh Benguet thành Đường Cong. Andres Acop Cosalan
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อถนน Gurel-Bokod-Kabayan-Abatan ในจังหวัด Benguet เป็นถนน Cong. Andres Acop Cosalan
title.id: Undang-Undang Mengubah Nama Jalan Gurel-Bokod-Kabayan-Abatan di Provinsi Benguet menjadi Jalan Cong. Andres Acop Cosalan
title.ms: Akta Menukar Nama Jalan Gurel-Bokod-Kabayan-Abatan di Wilayah Benguet kepada Jalan Cong. Andres Acop Cosalan

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2018/ra_11061_2018.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: In recognition of his public service rendered to the people of the Province of Benguet from the sixth to Seventh Congress and the Interim Batasang Pambansa, The Gurel-Bokod-Kabayan-Abatan Road is renamed as the Cong. Andres Acop Cosalan Road.

The Department of Public Works and Highways shall place appropriate markers along the Cong. Andres Acop Cosalan Road and issue the necessary orders and circulars to implement the provision of this Act.
This Act shall take effect immediately upon approval.
